title: PingHarbor (clone of a real website)
tagline: A 5-page marketing site for an uptime-monitor app: scroll animation, light and dark theme, every link working, all text original.

steps.title: At a glance
steps.goal: Decide in two minutes: **is this the site I want built?** Nothing is built yet.

blocks.md: A **5-page website** (Home, Blog with article views, Article, Features, Download) built with no build step: a sticky header, a dark footer, a theme that follows the system with a toggle, and content that animates in as you scroll. The brand is **PingHarbor**, a small Windows app that checks your sites on a timer. All text is original; the reference site's names, logos and sentences are never reused.

items.v: Teams who want a polished marketing-style site fast, and a **test of whether a builder can reproduce a real site from a written plan alone**
Sections, order, type, colours and motion are **measured** from the reference. Brand, every word, logo and mock data are **invented**
Audit score 80 or more with no high finding (step 5)
One question: is 80 the bar for done? Default yes

items.title: Home
items.text: hero, bento, AI split, channels, steps
items.detail: Hero with an app-window mock (9 sites x 40 heat-map cells), 8-card feature bento, AI-assistant split with chat mock, alert channels, status-page split, 3 how-it-works steps, sister products, download band, latest posts.

items.title: Blog
items.detail: Category, date, author on each card; a card opens its own article view at `#/blog/<slug>`; an unknown slug shows "Article not found".

items.title: Article
items.detail: Back link, chip, meta; 680 px reading column with callout, code block, pull quote; author card; "Keep reading" 3 cards; CTA band; reading progress bar.

items.title: Download
items.detail: Download button, install and verify steps, what happens next, closing band.

items.title: Header, footer, navigation
items.text: sticky 56 px header, dark footer, mobile menu
items.detail: **A dead link is a defect.** Every link is a real route or a full URL; never `#`.

blocks.title: Layout of the Home page (builder file)

steps.title: Look and motion
steps.goal: Say **"keep" or "change"** to the look before anyone builds.

items.title: One green accent
items.detail: Eyebrows, one highlighted word per heading, buttons, dates. `#059669` light / `#10b981` dark; small accent text on light must use `#047857` (readable).

items.title: Light and dark
items.text: follows the system, toggle in header
items.detail: The toggle sets `dark-theme`, kept in the browser, applied before first paint so there is no flash (F7).

items.title: Type
items.detail: Hero heading 72 px (mobile 40), section heading 48 px (mobile 32), body 16/1.6.

items.title: Layout
items.detail: Sections about 96 px apart (64 mobile); grids collapse to one column under 768 px.

steps.title: How the build works
steps.goal: Click through **who does what**, so you know the plan can be built in parallel.

blocks.title: Rules that make the clone work

items.title: Linking
items.text: a dead link is a defect

items.title: Own brand and text
items.detail: Never the reference's names, logos or sentences. Mock content is believable and specific: 4-8 posts with dates, authors, categories. Never lorem ipsum, never TODO.

items.title: One owner per file
items.detail: builder 1: `part-1` (Home + Blog); builder 2: `part-2` (Features + Article); builder 3: `part-3` (Download). Kit files are never edited.

items.title: Blog slugs defined once
items.detail: `security-headers-2026`, `ai-crawler-robots`, `saas-status-pages`, `tls-certificates-2026`, `windows-uptime-guide`, `welcome-to-the-blog`. (The first audit found two briefs listing different slugs.)

steps.title: Decisions and quality
steps.goal: One question is open; here is **the bar for done**.

items.default: no reference capture (it is in build_inputs); no questions; builders in parallel
no build; Vue 3 from a CDN; kit files are not edited
one brief per screens file; a builder starts the moment its brief exists

items.q: A lone builder for a site
Is a score of 80 on the site audit the bar for done?

blocks.title: Quality bar
items: Site audit score 80 or more with 0 high findings (the earlier run ended at 72: 1 high, 4 medium, 3 low)
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 on every page, light and dark, desktop and mobile
Tap targets at least 40x40 px on a phone
Every page has a meta description, headings stay in order, no text under 12 px
No dead link and no "not found" behind a link
Reduced-motion and mobile (390 px) checked; the original brand name never appears

steps.title: Phase 1 · Kit and contract
steps.goal: **An empty site with working header, footer, theme and five routes.**

blocks.title: Done when
items: the project folder exists with the 5 routes
header and footer link to EVERY page
theme follows the system and has a toggle
content marked for reveal animates on scroll

items.what: Run the site kit for project `pingharbor`: accent #10b981, DM Sans, dark background #0e1318, 5 routes
Check the contract matches the generated PROTO.md (routes, owners, linking rules)

steps.title: Phase 2 · Build the pages
steps.goal: **Five linked pages with original text, built by three builders at once.**

blocks.title: Done when
items: every page replaced its stub (no 'TODO', no lorem ipsum)
all links resolve; the six blog slugs work; an unknown slug shows 'Article not found'
dark theme works; original text and brand only
each builder touched only its own two files

items.what: Home (sections S1-S9) and Blog list with article views

steps.title: Phase 3 · Verify and fix
steps.goal: **Measured quality: audit score 80 or more, defects fixed.**

blocks.title: Done when
items: audit score 80 or more with 0 high findings
all 5 pages reachable from the header on desktop and phone

items.what: Site audit + preview (the picture compare is not possible: no live reference is supplied)
Fix contrast: small accent text on light uses `#047857`; all text 4.5:1 or better
Fix phone tap targets (40x40 px), add a meta description to every page, keep heading order, no text under 12 px

steps.title: Who owns which file
steps.goal: **No file is owned twice.** Kit files are never edited.
